All five applicants are followers of the United Macedonian Organisation Ilinden – Party for Economic Development and Integration of the Population (UMO Ilinden – PIRIN).
UMO Ilinden – PIRIN is a political party founded in 1998.
UMO Ilinden – PIRIN is based in south-western Bulgaria, in an area known as the Pirin region or the geographic region of Pirin Macedonia.
UMO Ilinden – PIRIN apparently has links with the United Macedonian Organisation Ilinden (UMO Ilinden), an association also based in south-western Bulgaria.
UMO Ilinden advocates similar ideas to UMO Ilinden – PIRIN.
UMO Ilinden – PIRIN was declared unconstitutional by the Bulgarian Constitutional Court on 29 February 2000.
As a result of being declared unconstitutional by the Bulgarian Constitutional Court, UMO Ilinden – PIRIN was dissolved.
